page.overview:
Who is Lin Kuei?

Lin Kuei is a minor character and member of Sub-Zero's clan that briefly appears in Mortal Kombat X and is a playable character in Mortal Kombat Mobile.

The Lin Kuei wears a black hood over his head and a black and gray facemask with breathing holes over his mouth. He also wears a blue and gray metal chestplate with two Lin Kuei symbols over it along with black and gray metal plates over his shoulders and biceps.
